title: KMZ: Koopman–Mori-Zwanzig model reduction, Lean formal proofs and Python library
description: Python library kmz (prediction and analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems from data via the Koopman operator and the Mori–Zwanzig formalism) and Lean 4 + Mathlib formal proofs (memory-kernel bounds, memory = residual autocorrelation, exact discrete Mori–Zwanzig identity) accompanying the paper.
